conversations-literal-v2.number_spelling_and_other_tokenization: Retained in raw WER and discussed separately; no reference/model word merging or repairs.

alignment.repetition_warning: Traceback indices are not identities of indistinguishable spoken duplicates.

metrics.filler_tp: Reference filler aligned as exact normalized match
metrics.filler_fn: Reference filler without exact normalized match
metrics.filler_fp: Predicted filler not accounted for by a reference-filler exact match
metrics.uncertainty: Keep canonical score plus all predeclared alternatives; never silently select a favorable reference.

format_diagnostic_limit: Declared after baseline/Turbo outputs were inspected, before the later full-AMI candidate. Diagnostic only; not independent validation or permission to alter predictions.
